vocabulary.title: Aortic Stenosis
vocabulary.description: A structural narrowing of the aortic valve opening, restricting vital blood outflow from the left ventricle into the systemic aorta.

vocabulary.title: Bradycardia
vocabulary.description: An abnormally slow resting heart rate condition, typically documented when parameters fall below 60 beats per minute in adult charts.

vocabulary.title: Dyspnea
vocabulary.description: Subjective distressful sensation of labored or uncomfortable breathing, routinely charting as Shortness of Breath during intake triage.

vocabulary.title: Gastroesophageal Reflux
vocabulary.description: A persistent chronic digestive disorder where highly acidic gastric contents regurgitate backwards into the esophageal path.

vocabulary.title: Hypertension
vocabulary.description: A major systemic circulatory cardiovascular condition marked by a chronic elevation of arterial pressure forces above 130/80 mmHg.
